name_bullet.instructions: Which bullet of the pull request description does this group of changes implement?

criteria.b1: `getUser` takes a required `GetUserOptions` argument (`include`, `fresh`, `signal`); all callers updated
criteria.b2: Move `ApiError`, auth headers and error parsing into `api/errors.ts` and add `isNotFound`
criteria.b3: Add `useProfileCache`: stale-while-revalidate cache with a 5 minute TTL and request de-duplication
criteria.b4: Add `Avatar` and `ProfileHeader` components; `ProfilePage` uses the cache and shows save errors
criteria.b5: Invalidate the profile cache on logout
criteria.none: implements none of the listed bullets
